laneFActiveUsLast24h._about: Lane F's real pull (docs/classifieds/vin-history.md on lane-f-forsale-vins at d10a771c, Nov 18 2026): US listings last seen in the 24 hours before the pull, by source. Counts only.

syncDocs._about: From https://oldcarsdata.com/docs/classifieds#polling-for-changes, read Nov 19 2026 (not a metered call). The published openapi.json (https://api.oldcarsdata.com/openapi.json) did NOT yet list changed_since, last_seen_before, next_sync_cursor or changed_at on Nov 19 06:00 UTC; a live read of GET /classifieds with them answered 200 (10 queries, Nov 19). The stand-in is built from the docs and those reads.
syncDocs.changed_since: inclusive changed_at lower bound, ISO 8601 with a timezone offset; orders by changed_at then id; routine presence checks do not move changed_at; use status=all
syncDocs.last_seen_before: strictly before this cutoff; equal and unknown last_seen_at excluded; never changes a status
syncDocs.checkpoint: with changed_since and direction=asc the last complete page carries meta.next_sync_cursor; passed back as cursor with the same filters it skips the completed (changed_at, id) boundary; an empty resumed poll also returns one; an initial empty search without a prior cursor has none
syncDocs.pageCursor: expires 24 hours after the first page; a changed filter, an expired or malformed cursor is HTTP 400; checkpoints have no time expiry
syncDocs.observed: updated_at moves on every presence check (Nov 18 probe); changed_at does not (docs); changed_at is published in batches (Nov 19: 63 and 35 listings of one dealer share an instant); a listing's asking_price_history is [{price, observed_at}] oldest first
